title: Create resizable editor shell connected to processor
description:
Create the minimal ShredBoost editor shell in Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp, connected to the processor created in a.1.

Requirements:
- Declare class ShredBoostAudioProcessorEditor : public juce::AudioProcessorEditor, holding a reference to ShredBoostAudioProcessor.
- Constructor takes ShredBoostAudioProcessor& and calls setSize() with a reasonable default (e.g. 600x400) and setResizable(true, true).
- Implement paint() to fill the background and draw the "ShredBoost" name/placeholder text; implement resized() (may be empty for now).
- Ensure Source/PluginProcessor.cpp's createEditor() returns a new ShredBoostAudioProcessorEditor(*this). If a.1 left createEditor as a placeholder, update it minimally to construct the real editor.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp from a.1 for the processor class name and createEditor() signature.
- ./JUCE/modules/juce_audio_processors/juce_audio_processors.h for AudioProcessorEditor (do NOT modify anything under JUCE/).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: ShredBoostAudioProcessorEditor derives from juce::AudioProcessorEditor and holds a ShredBoostAudioProcessor reference
Constructor calls setResizable(true, true) and setSize()
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp createEditor() returns a new ShredBoostAudioProcessorEditor
No file outside allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change isBusesLayoutSupported or processBlock logic in PluginProcessor.cpp
add GUI controls or parameter bindings (deferred to later phases)
